title: From seed to flower
description: Observe planting, watering, sprouting, stem growth and blooming in order.

lessons.tip: Ask your child to point to what goes into the soil before the plant grows.
lessons.mission: Turn off the screen and, with a grown-up, point to where a seed could go in a pot or garden bed.

lessons.tip: Pretend together to give the plant a little water rather than too much.
lessons.mission: Turn off the screen and, with a grown-up, give a plant a little water or pretend with an empty cup.

lessons.meaning: a sprout emerging from the soil
lessons.tip: Use your hands to compare the tiny sprout with the taller stem.

lessons.tip: Trace the stem upward and count the leaves together.
lessons.mission: Turn off the screen, stretch your arms up like a stem and spread your fingers like leaves.

lessons.tip: Act out seed, sprout, stem and flower in order.

title: Animals in their places
description: Observe five animals pictured in a nest, underwater, by a burrow, in a tree and underground.

lessons.tip: Find the nest and branch in the picture, and explain that this bird can use the nest for its eggs and chicks.

lessons.tip: Point to the waterline and fins, then talk about how the fish moves underwater.

lessons.tip: Point separately to the burrow entrance and rabbit, then ask where this rabbit is sitting.

lessons.tip: Trace the trunk upward and find both the squirrel and the tree hollow.

lessons.tip: Find the line between above and below ground, then trace the underground tunnel used by the ant.

title: Healthy and safe habits
description: Learn cough, screen-break, stair and water safety, and take medicine only from a parent, caregiver or authorized health professional.

lessons.meaning: Cover a cough or sneeze with your elbow
lessons.tip: Use the picture to review covering the mouth and nose with the inside of the elbow for a cough or sneeze.
lessons.mission: Turn off the screen and, while seated, slowly practise bringing the inside of the elbow toward the mouth and nose. Do not force a cough.

lessons.meaning: Take a screen break and look at something far away
lessons.tip: Practise briefly looking away from the screen toward a distant indoor view; do not present this as eyesight treatment.
lessons.mission: Turn off the screen and briefly look toward a distant wall or a safe view from indoors. Never look directly at the sun.

lessons.meaning: Hold the handrail and walk on stairs
lessons.tip: Explain that stairs require walking with a grown-up and holding the handrail; do not practise on real stairs for this activity.
lessons.mission: Turn off the screen and, with a grown-up, point to stairs and a handrail in a picture book. Do not go to real stairs for this activity.

lessons.korean: 약은 부모·보호자나 허락된 보건 담당자가 줄 때만 먹어요
lessons.meaning: Take medicine only when a parent, caregiver or authorized health professional gives it to you
lessons.tip: Never take or share medicine alone; only a parent, caregiver or authorized health professional may give it.
lessons.mission: Turn off the screen and point to a parent, caregiver or authorized health professional in a photo or picture book. Do not touch, take or share real medicine.

lessons.meaning: Stay with a grown-up near water
lessons.tip: Near water, stay with a caregiver, keep a safe distance and follow their rules. Use pictures only; do not approach real water for this activity.
lessons.mission: Turn off the screen and, with a caregiver, point to a safe distance from water in a picture book. Do not approach real water for this activity.
